contextCompiler.purpose: Compile minimum sufficient, evidence-linked context for one task without replacing HEAD authority.
contextCompiler.authority: Materialized context is derived and rebuildable; canonical sources and user-owned decisions remain authoritative.
contextCompiler.failurePolicy: Fail closed on canon drift; harness adapters may fail open to normal agent operation when compilation is unavailable.

executionLineage.purpose: Connect whole-plan authority, bounded execution, evidence-linked results, and HEAD review without relying on provider conversation state.
executionLineage.identity: Artifacts use content-derived identifiers, digest verification, and typed parent relationships.
executionLineage.status: Contract-bound Runs, evidence-linked Result Packets, deterministic Fresh HEAD review projections, ReviewDecision-linked plan generations, and authority-free knowledge proposals are active; provider runtime hydration and authorized promotion are deferred.

productModel.purpose: Preserve user-owned product intent independently from repository layout and project it into rebuildable temporal evidence.
productModel.authority: The source document is mutable user-owned project canon. Graph nodes, graph edges, ContextCapsule ProductContext, and documents are derived projections and cannot mutate or promote canon.
productModel.status: Strict schema validation, stable logical keys, immutable content-derived revisions, Git-independent GraphSnapshot projection, bounded Context Compiler selection, onboarding ReviewDecision promotion, reviewed product-to-code/test mappings, and reviewed ChangeSet impact are active; general relationship promotion remains deferred.

onboarding.purpose: Bootstrap a project-scoped HEAD Session and Product Canon without silently turning observed code, documentation, model inference, or storage capability into authority.
inputs: existing project World Model plus provider HEAD semantic proposal
onboarding.authority: Candidates and GraphSnapshots remain non-authoritative. Only an explicit ReviewDecision with decisionScope product-canon-bootstrap may create a new Product Canon revision.
onboarding.storage: Local JSON is complete by default. GraphDB endpoint, database, and secret-reference names may be recorded as pending operational configuration; credential values are rejected and the remote adapter is not claimed active.
onboarding.status: Project-scoped Session records, deterministic state migration, evidence-linked bounded HEAD semantic proposals, stale-source rejection, batch review, immutable decision receipts, Product Canon revision history, onboarding receipt GraphSnapshot projection, and post-promotion GraphSnapshot verification are active.

computeAdapter.purpose: Delegate deterministic heavy computation without changing semantic identity or transferring authority from the JavaScript control plane.
computeAdapter.identity: Canonical operation, input digest, semantic producer, and normalized limits determine the request; canonical complete output determines the result digest. Backend diagnostics are excluded.
computeAdapter.authority: Computation only with no instruction, promotion, control, project-mutation, or canon-mutation authority.
computeAdapter.status: Strict request/response validation, resource limits, timeout/cancellation, structured errors, authority-escalation rejection, verified Go stdio transport, platform manifest integrity checks, bounded exact-child lifecycle, disclosed JavaScript fallback, and health-response conformance are active. A Go repository.scan.v1 candidate is complete-response conformant, but production manifests retain the JavaScript path because measured benefit is not yet material across repository sizes.

runtimeAdapters.purpose: Define a provider-neutral runtime, platform, and workspace-host boundary for privacy-bounded discovery, supervised one-shot execution, and authority-free coordination.
runtimeAdapters.identity: Static descriptor, discovery, bounded version/help observation, project/Session binding, invocation authorization, immutable lease consumption/release, event envelope, lifecycle receipt, and ResultPacket draft identities are content-derived; provider sessions, raw commands/output, project paths, prompts, transcripts, credentials, live process IDs, and physical adapter identity are excluded.
runtimeAdapters.authority: Capability, continuation outcomes, dispatch wait cursors, and coordination replies never grant authorization. Runtime invocation remains bound to Session or exact Run/ExecutionContract authority, while bounded interrupt/close applies only to one exact owned one-shot provider tree.
runtimeAdapters.status: Codex/OpenCode discovery, live Session/Run invocation, fresh-process replacement, P2-first optional exact HEAD attachment, independently owned bounded-worker dispatch/review/integration, already-running exact-endpoint coordination, bounded non-authoritative reply wait, and token-fenced one-shot interrupt/close are active. General provider-session resume/stream, broader host control, and host-specific TUI integration remain disabled.

worldModel.purpose: Materialize rebuildable repository file, symbol, dependency, import, and call evidence for task-specific compilation.
worldModel.store: replaceable-rebuildable-materialized-view via a versioned WorldModelStoreAdapter; local-json is the active adapter
worldModel.authority: Derived evidence only; project canon and user-owned decisions remain authoritative.
worldModel.coverage: Supported text files, heuristic symbols/dependencies, evidence-linked file/symbol/import/call graph, user-owned Product Model canon, Git-independent temporal revisions, reviewed mappings/ChangeSets/impacts, optional VCS evidence, immutable onboarding/document-review receipts, bounded traversal, replaceable graph/document projections, incremental refresh, current-host runtime evidence, canonical HEAD project/Session binding, non-executing runtime invocation authorization, durable at-most-once lease receipts, and lifecycle schema conformance are active; actual provider runtime control, AST-accurate analysis, Obsidian/Notion, live ArcadeDB performance evaluation, and compare-and-swap remote publication are deferred.

incrementalRefresh.purpose: Reconstruct changed observed project state as a new immutable World Model and GraphSnapshot without mutating canon or accepted execution inputs.
incrementalRefresh.identity: The request binds the verified base World Model and SourceSnapshot, trigger evidence, exact or discovered path expectation, and explicit additional source parents. The receipt binds verified before/after World Model, SourceSnapshot, GraphSnapshot, change, revision-transition, and execution-drift evidence.
incrementalRefresh.incrementalBoundary: Every eligible file is rediscovered and byte-hashed; semantic analysis is reused only when path, digest, byte length, classification, language, and source-analysis protocol match the verified prior snapshot. The resulting RepositoryScanResult must equal a complete reference scan.
incrementalRefresh.authority: Refresh updates observed derived state only. A separate explicit post-refresh policy may regenerate an unedited derived Markdown view, but neither layer can mutate Product Canon, promote candidates, grant instruction authority, or replace an active Run's pinned ContextCapsule.
incrementalRefresh.status: Explicit CLI refresh, immutable request/receipt artifacts, automatic current-source parent linkage, unchanged-revision identity reuse, changed-revision parent linkage, exact changed-path expectations, active-Run drift disclosure, deterministic bounded filesystem/CI trigger batches, a foreground filesystem watcher, structured CI ingestion, single-writer serialization, immutable delivery receipts, opt-in automatic Markdown projection, and read-only CLI/MCP inspection are active; remote GraphDB refresh remains deferred.

temporalProvenance.purpose: Connect stable product and repository entities to immutable content-derived revisions and explicit multiple-parent ancestry without requiring Git or GraphDB.
temporalProvenance.identity: Logical identities exclude line locations, Git objects, GraphDB records, provider sessions, and document page IDs; revisions and graph/query/result artifacts are digest-verifiable.
temporalProvenance.authority: Rebuildable derived evidence only with no instruction, promotion, canonical, or unique authority.
temporalProvenance.status: Product Canon projection, immutable onboarding and document-review receipts, reviewed product-to-code/test mappings, reviewed ChangeSets and impacts, optional VCS evidence, default candidate-space exclusion, zero-or-more SourceSnapshot/Revision/ChangeSet parents, deterministic bounded traversal, and local/in-memory/ArcadeDB GraphProjectionAdapter backends are active; automatic merge, conflict resolution, general candidate promotion, compare-and-swap publication, and non-ArcadeDB remote backends are deferred.

documentProjection.purpose: Render one verified GraphSnapshot as a deterministic human-facing view without changing graph or project authority.
documentProjection.authority: Derived human view only with no instruction, promotion, canonical, or unique authority.
documentProjection.identity: GraphSnapshot identity, renderer protocol, deterministic relative paths, exact content digests, and authority flags determine DocumentProjection identity; adapter kind and physical locations are excluded.
documentProjection.status: Local and in-memory adapters, bounded index/node/relation pages, explicit generation/status, published-view drift protection, adapter conformance, immutable DocumentChangeCandidate capture, a manual safe default, explicit automatic mode, immutable post-refresh receipts, explicit document review, exact structured Product Canon application, immutable application receipts, and temporal audit projection are active; Obsidian and Notion remain deferred.

roles.head: Owns whole-outcome understanding, strategy, integration, and completion judgment.
roles.developer: Owns one bounded, independently consumable implementation result.
roles.coder: Implements a fully decided Run contract without changing observable behavior.
roles.reviewer: Evaluates consequential decisions before implementation without choosing the final direction.

invariants: The user retains material product, policy, architecture, cost, workflow, and external-action authority.
Canonical project state outranks conversation summaries and transient logs.
A project identifier maps to one canonical project root.
Managed files are never overwritten after user modification.
Runtime-specific sessions remain distinct from HEAD session and Run identifiers.
